decision: Client project, single company with multi-branch, no SaaS shell
reason: Work mode is client delivery for one SME with several branches. The tenancy kernel is cheap now and expensive to retrofit, so it stays. The SaaS entitlement chain has no buyer in this engagement and building it is unpaid over-engineering. Data scope (own/team/branch) becomes the PRIMARY authorization axis rather than tenant isolation
chosen: Build the company tenancy kernel (company_id + global scope) but NOT packages, subscriptions, platform-owner console or billing
alternatives: Full SaaS shell as in SMEOS
author: Fakrul
title: Client project, single company with multi-branch, no SaaS shell

reason: Inherits the only production-tested multi-tenant isolation kernel and reflection-driven isolation suite the developer owns (~60 percent of the kernel). PostgreSQL supplies CHECK constraints, partial/expression indexes for scoped queries, indexed JSONB for commission calc_inputs and attribution raw, window functions for ladders and ageing, and exact NUMERIC. The hardest problem on this project is authorization correctness across 22 modules with two scoping dimensions, not order throughput or CRUD volume
chosen: Option 1, SMEOS lineage: Laravel 12 LTS, PHP 8.3, PostgreSQL 16, ULID keys, NUMERIC(15,4) with a bcmath Money value object, Inertia 3 + React 19 + TypeScript + Bootstrap 5, spatie/laravel-permission teams mode, Pest 3 + Larastan + Pint
alternatives: Option 2 OMS lineage (Laravel 13.8 + MariaDB + integer cents)
evidence: Read SMEOS and SaaS-OMS architectures in full; surveyed 36 sibling Laravel projects
author: Fakrul
title: Stack: Laravel 12 + PostgreSQL 16 + Inertia/React 19/TS/Bootstrap 5

decision: Authorization is Permission x DataScope, built into the kernel from commit one
reason: No prior system of the five inspected has a data-scope model. SMEOS records that adding a second scoping dimension later roughly doubles the isolation test surface. dzi-holistik enforces ownership per controller (abort_unless repeated 8 times in one file) where one missed line is a leak. With a single client company, data scope is the primary authorization axis
chosen: Scope stored on the role-permission pivot (role_permission_scopes) with values own/team/branch/company/all, resolved by a ScopeResolver and applied in the query layer through a Scopeable contract. Fail closed. Exactly one greppable escape hatch
alternatives: Flat permissions only as in SMEOS
Per-controller ownership checks as in dzi-holistik
author: Fakrul
title: Authorization is Permission x DataScope, built into the kernel from commit one

decision: Attribution is its own polymorphic domain; first-touch wins on tie-break
reason: Campaign and channel are absent as entities in all five prior systems; source exists as three unrelated free strings that nothing joins. First-touch rewards lead generation and protects marketers whose leads take weeks to convert, which fits the social-commerce profile. Freezing at order creation is required because commission is paid on the attribution and a campaign renamed six months later must not rewrite history
chosen: attributions + attribution_touches tables, polymorphic over Lead/Customer/Order. Every touch recorded. Commission credit goes to the FIRST touch (the marketer who originally generated the lead). Attribution resolved from the lead trail then FROZEN onto the order at creation
author: Fakrul
title: Attribution is its own polymorphic domain; first-touch wins on tie-break

decision: Commission pays a percentage of FULL gross margin (sales - cost - shipping - fees - ad spend)
reason: Fakrul chose the truest-profit basis (the dzi-holistik model). Consequence accepted: ad spend is attributed per campaign and period rather than per order, so per-order commission requires an allocation rule, and shipping and gateway fees are only known at settlement. That makes a two-stage provisional-then-final commission life mandatory rather than optional
chosen: Default commission plan strategy is PercentageOfMargin where margin = sales minus product cost minus shipping/postage minus payment fees minus allocated ad spend. Commission accrues PROVISIONALLY on estimates and is RESTATED at period close against reconciled actuals, with the restatement emitted as an audited adjustment entry, never a silent re-run
evidence: dzi-holistik CommissionService::grossProfitParts() and Order::effective*() reconciled-actuals pattern
author: Fakrul
title: Commission pays a percentage of FULL gross margin (sales - cost - shipping - fees - ad spend)

decision: Commission rules immutable and effective-dated; every commission stamps its rule version and basis
reason: Fixes ten anti-patterns verified in shipped code across dzi-holistik, AgentStockit and SAAS-Agent-Management, including two live duplicate-payment defects (calculation inline in a retrying gateway callback with no unique index; a payout sweep that never flips commissions to paid). Mutable rates with no effective dating silently rewrite closed periods. No prior system can name the rule that produced a commission
chosen: commission_rules + commission_rule_versions with valid_from/valid_to, immutable after creation. Every commission row persists rule_version_id, basis_amount, rate_type, rate_applied and calc_inputs jsonb, plus a commission_sources join to every contributing order line. Calculation runs in a queued job keyed on the order behind a DB unique index. Reversal is a contra entry, never a delete. Payout posts to Finance in the same transaction
alternatives: Mutable settings row as in all three prior systems
Rate on the plan without versioning
Recalculate on demand from current rules
author: Fakrul
title: Commission rules immutable and effective-dated; every commission stamps its rule version and basis
